title: List webhooks
summary: Returns the webhooks of your app, oldest first. Signing secrets are never returned.

title: Create a webhook
summary: Registers an endpoint that Relay calls when an event happens. The signing secret is returned once.

fields.name: url
fields.description: A public https URL, up to 2048 characters, without credentials. Private and local hosts are refused.

fields.name: events
fields.description: At least one event. The only event is mailbox.received. Duplicates are merged.

fields.name: secret
fields.description: Your own signing secret, 16 to 256 characters. When omitted, Relay generates one.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Set to false to register the webhook paused.

responseNote: The body is not wrapped in data. Store the secret now: no endpoint returns it again.

errors.when: The body is not valid JSON or fails validation, including a non-public url.
Relay cannot sign webhooks right now. Try again later.

title: Update a webhook
summary: Changes the fields you send. Every field is optional, and the secret cannot be changed here.
responseNote: The body is the webhook and is not wrapped in data.

errors.when: The body is not valid JSON or fails validation.
The webhook does not exist or belongs to another app.
The webhook does not exist or belongs to another app.
